one_line_reason: All three shortlisted records measure norvaline as an endogenous blood/plasma biomarker in metabolomics studies, not as an administered oral supplement.
blockers: No shortlisted record administers L-norvaline as a supplement; all are observational metabolomics/biomarker studies.

excluded_pmids.reason: Systematic review of metabolomic biomarkers for head and neck cancer detection; norvaline appears only as one endogenous biofluid metabolite among many biomarker panel candidates, not as a supplement intervention.
Observational metabolomics study of diabetic kidney disease progression; norvaline is measured as an endogenous plasma metabolite associated with outcome, not administered as a supplement.

Crossover trial of sitting-interruption modalities (standing/walking breaks) in postmenopausal women measuring postprandial metabolome changes; a norvaline derivative is one of many endogenous metabolites measured, not a supplement intervention.
